title: Windows terminal sessions need fresh environment variables
symptom_summary: New terminal tabs in a running VS Code window use the old environment. Changes made outside the application become available after restarting VS Code.
repro_steps: Modify the environment or install a command outside a running VS Code instance.
Create another integrated terminal and check for the change.

title: Mouse drag events are missing from terminals in auxiliary windows
symptom_summary: A terminal with xterm mouse tracking sends drag events in the main editor. After moving it to a separate window, it loses drag and mouse-up events.
repro_steps: Start a Linux Bash terminal through WSL or SSH.
Enable xterm mouse tracking and observe events in the main window.
Move the terminal to a new window and compare drag events.

title: Accepting a terminal command suggestion should add a space
symptom_summary: The completion inserts the command alone. The reporter has to type a separator before adding arguments.

title: Finding text in a large terminal buffer blocks the renderer
symptom_summary: With thousands of lines of scrollback, typing and backspacing in terminal find gets slow.
repro_steps: Generate a large amount of terminal output with scrollback set to 50,000.
Open terminal find and type or erase query text.
